## Gnosys Memory System

This project uses **Gnosys** for persistent memory via MCP. Gnosys uses a centralized brain (`~/.gnosys/gnosys.db`) shared across all projects with project, user, and global scopes.

### Read first

- At task start, call `gnosys_hybrid_search` with relevant keywords, then load full bodies with `gnosys_read`
- Use `gnosys_recall` for a context block when the user references past decisions
- Use `gnosys_briefing` for project activity or `gnosys_dashboard` for system health

### Write automatically

- Always write with `gnosys_add_structured`. Supply title, category, tags, content, and relevance yourself; it makes no server-side LLM call
- When the user says "remember", "save this", or "note this down", save a memory
- Save decisions, specs, and plans before work; save findings and gotchas after significant implementation
- Save user preferences with `gnosys_preference_set`; inspect them with `gnosys_preference_get`

### Core tools

| Action | Tool |
|--------|------|
| Search | `gnosys_hybrid_search` (keyword, semantic, or hybrid) then `gnosys_read` |
| Context | `gnosys_recall` |
| Write | `gnosys_add_structured` |
| Update or archive | `gnosys_update` (status archived or superseded; hard deletion is human-only via CLI) |
| Feedback | `gnosys_reinforce` (usefulness), `gnosys_reflect` (outcome and confidence) |
| Relationships | `gnosys_traverse` |
| Preferences | `gnosys_preference_set`, `gnosys_preference_get` |
| Projects | `gnosys_init`, `gnosys_briefing`, `gnosys_dashboard` |
| More tools | `gnosys_toolset` (omit arguments for the catalog) |

### After gnosys_toolset {"set":"standard"}

- Use `gnosys_federated_search` for scope boosts, `gnosys_discover` for metadata, or `gnosys_search` for keyword snippets
- Use `gnosys_semantic_search` for embedding-only ranking or `gnosys_working_set` for recently modified memories
- Use `gnosys_trace` to write procedural memories from code; re-runs create duplicates

### After gnosys_toolset {"set":"full"}

- Use `gnosys_reindex` to build embeddings or `gnosys_export` to export an Obsidian vault
- NEVER call the freeform `gnosys_add`: the server rejects it with an error for agents. It exists only for operator-enabled non-agent scripts with GNOSYS_ALLOW_FREEFORM_ADD=1; always use `gnosys_add_structured`

### Project routing

**IMPORTANT:** Always pass the `projectRoot` parameter with every Gnosys tool call, set to the workspace root directory. This ensures memories are stored and retrieved for the correct project. Without it, Gnosys may route to the wrong project in multi-project setups.

### Categories

`architecture` · `decisions` · `requirements` · `concepts` · `roadmap` · `landscape` · `open-questions`

### Keeping these instructions current

This block is generated by Gnosys and can drift from the installed version. After upgrading Gnosys (or if guidance here looks stale), run the CLI command `gnosys sync` to regenerate this section in every detected IDE rules file (CLAUDE.md, .cursor/rules, .codex). Your user preferences and project conventions are re-injected at the same time.
